en_title: Christopher Judge Slams God of War TV Series Showrunners For Not Hiring Writers of the Games
cn_title: 奎托斯演员质疑《战神》剧集弃用游戏编剧
subtitle: 谁最懂这个世界
opus_summary: Christopher Judge批评《战神》剧集未聘用游戏编剧，认为游戏编剧更了解这个世界。剧集因主演受伤换角，Dave Bautista洽谈接替，预计秋季复拍。

paragraphs.en: Kratos actor Christopher Judge has a bit of a bone to pick with adaptations of video games like God of War , particularly when they don't involve the people who created the games in the first place.
paragraphs.cn: 饰演奎托斯的Christopher Judge对《战神》等电子游戏改编作品颇有意见，尤其反感改编项目一开始就没有邀请原游戏创作者参与。

paragraphs.en: When speaking on a panel at a FanExpo convention earlier this summer , Judge got on the subject of video game adaptations. The actor expressed frustrations over the adaptations not using the cast and creatives for the games, especially when they aren't changing much about their stories. He specifically pointed to God of War, feeling baffled that the writers of the games weren't hired to also write the show.
paragraphs.cn: 今年夏天早些时候在FanExpo活动的一场座谈会上，Judge谈起了电子游戏改编。对于改编作品没有启用游戏原班演员和创作人员一事，这位演员颇为不满，尤其是当它们并未对游戏故事做太多改动时。他特别提到了《战神》，不解于游戏编剧竟没有受邀参与剧集创作。

paragraphs.en: "My problem with all game adaptations [is] you have this pre-existing, successful property, and the first thing you do is not hire anyone associated with it," said Judge. "The Last of Us — love Pedro [Pascal]— were they better than the game cast? I saw a stage reading that they did. It was unreal. I have no idea why you don't take that cast, those writers, especially when you are going to do episodes that are shot-for-shot remakes of the game.
paragraphs.cn: Judge说道：「我对所有游戏改编作品都有一个问题：你手头明明有一部已经存在且成功的作品，结果做的第一件事却是不聘用任何与它有关的人。《最后生还者》——我喜欢Pedro Pascal——他们比游戏演员更好吗？我看过他们参加的一场舞台读剧，简直不可思议。尤其是在你们打算制作逐镜头重现游戏的剧集时，我实在不明白为什么不直接用那批演员和编剧。」

paragraphs.en: "When Amazon [announced the God of War TV series] and they didn't hire any of the God of War writers... what are you thinking? These guys have been immersed in this world for 20 years. But someone's going to know better?"
paragraphs.cn: 「亚马逊宣布《战神》电视剧，却没有聘用任何《战神》编剧时……你们到底在想什么？这些人沉浸在这个世界里已经20年了。但你们觉得会有人比他们更懂？」

paragraphs.en: Longtime God of War creative Cory Barlog is an executive producer on the show alongside PlayStation boss Hermen Hulst, but it's unclear how involved they are. The Last of Us creator Neil Druckmann was a showrunner, writer, and director on the first two seasons of HBO's adaptation of the Naughty Dog series, so he was an integral piece of the process. It's unclear if Barlog is as hands-on as Druckmann, or if he's given the executive producer credit just because of his history with the game franchise.
paragraphs.cn: 长期参与《战神》创作的Cory Barlog与PlayStation负责人Hermen Hulst一同担任该剧执行制片人，但目前不清楚他们具体参与了多少工作。《最后生还者》创作者Neil Druckmann曾担任HBO根据顽皮狗游戏系列改编的剧集前两季的剧集主管、编剧和导演，因此在制作过程中发挥了关键作用。目前不清楚Barlog是否像Druckmann一样亲自深度参与制作，还是仅凭他与该游戏系列的渊源获得执行制片人署名。

paragraphs.en: Judge's comments also come at a rather interesting time. Filming was shut down on the God of War TV series in July after the show's Kratos actor, Ryan Hurst, was injured while performing a stunt on set. The actor's injury was so severe that production has opted to recast the role, with Dave Bautista recently entering talks with the studio to inherit the part. Filming is expected to restart this fall. Some hoped that the show would take this opportunity to cast Judge as the live-action Kratos, as he has the build, voice, and a deep understanding of the character. However, it doesn't appear that this will be the case.
paragraphs.cn: Judge发表这些言论的时机也相当特别。《战神》电视剧的拍摄工作于7月暂停，因为剧中奎托斯演员Ryan Hurst在片场表演特技时受伤。伤势严重到剧组决定重新选角，Dave Bautista最近已与制片方开始洽谈接替这一角色。剧组预计于今年秋季恢复拍摄。有人希望剧组能借此机会让Judge出演真人版奎托斯，因为他拥有合适的体格和声音，也深刻理解这个角色。但目前看来，事情似乎不会这样发展。

paragraphs.en: Judge will reprise his role in God of War Laufey early next year and is expected to lead a new Kratos-focused God of War game after that . Sony Santa Monica is also working on remakes of the original God of War trilogy , which will see original Kratos actor TC Carson returning to the role.
paragraphs.cn: 明年年初，Judge将回归《战神：劳菲》，继续饰演奎托斯；此后，他预计还会在一款聚焦奎托斯的新《战神》游戏中担任主角。索尼圣莫尼卡工作室也在开发原版《战神》三部曲的重制版，原版奎托斯演员TC Carson将回归，再次饰演这一角色。
